task: I want to put together a really easy beginner sketch reference pack for a casual drawing session, and I’d like you to grab the pieces in the browser so I can look at them afterward. First, on Pinterest, find one pin with a genuinely useful person drawing reference photo for figure practice—something clear enough that a beginner could sketch from—and open the actual pin page, then keep that tab open and save the pin link for me. Once you’ve got that figure reference, go to Google Images and search for a basic one-room hut from the 1500s in an English style so I can use it as a simple background setting; open the image result or source page that looks most believable and leave that open too so I can see the picture itself. After that, go to Bored Panda and open their collection of angry cat photos as a fun mood reference for the character expression, and tell me the exact page title while keeping that page open as well. In the end, send me the Pinterest pin link, the hut image or source page link, and the Bored Panda page title, plus a short note on how the figure, the hut, and the angry-cat mood could all work together in one simple sketch idea.
agent_final_answer:
Here is your beginner sketch reference pack with all three pages open in their own tabs for you to view:

### Open Tabs & Links

1. **Pinterest Figure Drawing Reference Pin**
   - **Tab:** Tab 2 (`Tab ID: 480038496`)
   - **Pin Link:** https://www.pinterest.com/pin/3166662228561777/
   - **Description:** A standing pose reference photo (*Art Models IrinaV537c*) featuring a clear contrapposto gesture, distinct body angles, and clean lighting that makes it easy for a beginner to map out the line of action, head tilt, torso box, and hip rhythm.

2. **1500s English Peasant Hut Setting**
   - **Tab:** Tab 1 (`Tab ID: 480038377`)
   - **Source Page Link:** https://www.worldhistory.org/image/9603/medieval-peasants-cottage/
   - **Description:** St. Mary's Grove thatched peasant cottage in Kent, England, showcasing a believable rustic rural setting with an overhanging straw thatch roof, small timbered windows, and aged wattle-and-daub walls.

3. **Bored Panda Angry Cat Mood Reference**
   - **Tab:** Tab 3 (`Tab ID: 480038497`)
   - **Exact Page Title:** `40 Times People Just Had To Snap A Pic Of Their Angry, But Cute Cats | Bored Panda`
   - **URL:** https://www.boredpanda.com/cute-angry-cats/
   - **Description:** A collection of comically disgruntled felines with flattened airplane ears, narrowed glaring eyes, and stern, scowling muzzles.

---

### Sketch Idea: "The Disgruntled Cottage Guard"
Place the English thatched hut in the midground with simple horizontal hatching and loose roof contours so it anchors the scene without getting cluttered. In the foreground, draw the figure leaning in the contrapposto pose against the hut's rustic wooden doorframe or fence post. Instead of a neutral face, adapt the cat's grumpy, squinting glare—heavy brows pressed down, flat skeptical mouth, and arms crossed or propped impatiently on the hips—as if they've just stepped outside their 16th-century cottage on a dreary morning to find a stray cat making the exact same grumpy face right at their feet.
